card1.title: Administrative Burden
card1.desc: Clinic doctors allocate a significant portion of consultation time to drafting medical records (SOAP/CPPT). Meanwhile, administrative staff face manual validation burdens on clinical documentation.

card2.title: Significant Impacts & Risks
card2.desc: Clerical errors can lead to delays in patient care and clinical record backlog. Excessive workload causes chronic burnout among medical staff, impacting the standard of patient care.
